For Blender blockout / proposed / not an as-built playable
Dimensions govern. All lengths in metres unless marked mm. Print A1 at 100%.
MAP REV 01 + DETAIL ISSUE B01 / 18 OCTOBER 2026
36 × 18 block plus two cores and external landing aprons
FRONT CONCOURSE / DO NOT FURNISH ACROSS ROUTES
36 × 18 block plus two cores and external landing aprons
FRONT CONCOURSE / DO NOT FURNISH ACROSS ROUTES
Set the block NW corner first. Homes sit at local (2,3) and (25,3),
both 9 × 8. Front concourse starts local z=11; rear landing is
z=0–3. Reserve only the two 2 × 8 side strips. Ground arcade at
Birch/Cedar: world z = block z + 18 - local z. Home origins become
local z=7, and home geometry mirrors within its 8 m footprint.
Public stair origin is block z - 6; the stair entrance faces north.
Do not rotate only the door labels.
The broad blue areas are common concourses/landings, not extra
flats. Open edges receive guards, brick piers and soffits; use
glazing only where scheduled. Keep both sides of every home exit
No wall crosses a shared hall, stair apron or the ground arcade. At
+3 the bridges connect between blocks. At +6 there is no inter-block
bridge. All floor plates are unions with holes, not overlapping
